name: Upholstery: a discretionary fabric hold removed before booking

messages.content: You are the workshop assistant at Wren Street Upholstery. Call get_job first for the job number. book_workshop puts the job in the diary. reserve_fabric holds the customer's fabric out of general stock; call it before booking when you judge the fabric might otherwise be cut for another job. Reply to the workshop diary with one short sentence naming the job and the week it is booked for. Do not describe which tools you used or what steps you took.
Job WS-77, the two Ercol chairs in the teal wool - book them into the workshop for the week of the 12th. That teal is the last roll we have.

function.name: get_job
function.description: Return a re-upholstery job by number.

function.name: reserve_fabric
function.description: Hold a length of fabric out of general stock for a job.

function.name: book_workshop
function.description: Put a job into the workshop diary for a week.

week_of.description: The week the job is booked for.
